title: Drive a circuit breaker with backoff and a half-open probe
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Per-state handlers follow the table exactly, and every path into the open state restarts the two-tick wait, including a failed probe.

An ok while closed does not reset the failure count, so plan_retries(["fail", "ok", "fail", "fail"]) trips on the last event instead of returning ("closed", ["retry 100", "pass", "retry 100", "retry 200"]).
A compact loop produces the specified action for every state and event, trips on the third consecutive failure and resets the wait on every trip.

A failed probe reopens the breaker without restarting the wait, so the brief's failed-probe example ends with "probe", "idle" instead of "wait", "probe", while the pasted log claims test_failed_probe_restarts_wait passed.
